g.text: 4-channel 4-20 mA input board for the Raspberry Pi 40-pin header - UNTESTED REFERENCE DESIGN

g.desc: 4-channel 4-20 mA input board for the Raspberry Pi 40-pin header - UNTESTED REFERENCE DESIGN

g.text: Each channel: PTC -> field terminal (+) -> transmitter -> field terminal (-) -> 150 R shunt -> 0 V,

g.desc: Each channel: PTC -> field terminal (+) -> transmitter -> field terminal (-) -> 150 R shunt -> 0 V,

g.text: with TVS on both field wires, 4.7k/100n RC filter and BAT54S clamp in front of the ADS1115 input.

g.desc: with TVS on both field wires, 4.7k/100n RC filter and BAT54S clamp in front of the ADS1115 input.

g.text: ADS1115 at 0x48 (ADDR = GND); move ADDR to VDD/SDA/SCL for 0x49/0x4A/0x4B to stack boards.

g.desc: ADS1115 at 0x48 (ADDR = GND); move ADDR to VDD/SDA/SCL for 0x49/0x4A/0x4B to stack boards.

g.text: One external 24 V supply feeds all loops through J5; its 0 V is the Pi GND (non-isolated design).

g.desc: One external 24 V supply feeds all loops through J5; its 0 V is the Pi GND (non-isolated design).

g.text: Not included: HAT+ ID EEPROM, mounting/keep-out, reverse-polarity protection, isolation,

g.desc: Not included: HAT+ ID EEPROM, mounting/keep-out, reverse-polarity protection, isolation,

g.text: GPIO-switchable 3.3 V rail for U1 (recommended for I2C recovery after a brown-out).

g.desc: GPIO-switchable 3.3 V rail for U1 (recommended for I2C recovery after a brown-out).
